rubric: An API change with no user-visible surface: screenshots_or_terminal (a terminal capture of the checks and the scenarios' tests).

criteria.format: an API or CLI change: screenshots when there is something to see, else a terminal capture of the commands and the scenarios' tests

reading.why: A batch endpoint with no web surface and no browser run: an API change, so a terminal capture of the checks.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: video
ruledOut.why: An API change with no surface. It is not: a UI or flow change a person should watch happen, and the browser run ran on a running system: scenarios the browser drove, a recording or replayable steps, and the video image is there.

ruledOut.question: format
ruledOut.label: text_only
ruledOut.why: An API change with no surface. It is not: CI/CD, config, infrastructure or a pure refactor: nothing a person could watch or run to see it.
